title: Unexpected Harvest
next_chapter_hook: As Chen Ji was lost in contemplation, a familiar aura came wafting from the direction of Tianqing Sect—that was Chen Ling's aura, mixed with a fluctuation he had never sensed before. On the chessboard of fate, a new variable had already entered the game.

text.content: In the very instant that the Eye of Heavenly Dao opened a thousand miles away, deep within the Forbidden Grounds of Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, Chen Ji sat cross-legged on a stone platform, spiritual energy flowing around him like rushing rivers. The seven days of seclusion after returning from the secret realm had reached a critical moment. He could clearly sense that the bloodline dormant in his body for many years was accelerating its awakening, like a coiling dragon about to break free from the abyss. Sweat slid down his temples, spreading dark water stains on the blue stone, but his breathing remained steady as ever.

"Almost there..." Chen Ji clenched his teeth, blood and qi churning within him like a tide. A low dragon's roar surged from the depths of his chest. That was the roar of his true dragon bloodline, the gift left by the Chen family's ancestors finally awakening completely. The fragment of the Tianji Record in his Mental Sea suddenly blazed with dazzling golden light, creating some kind of strange resonance with the blood pulsing through his veins. The residual medicinal power of the spirit fruit Ling Yuan had given him was completely ignited at this moment, transforming into a rushing torrent that surged against the gate points throughout his meridians.

dialogue.content: "Well done, sixty percent bloodline awakening. You have touched the threshold where Chen Xuan started back then." The remnant soul of Mo Xiansheng floated out from the first page of the Tianji Record, a rare flicker of relief appearing on his aged face. "But the true fortune lies within the Tianji Record itself."

text.content: Before his words could fade, a thunderclap suddenly exploded within Chen Ji's Mental Sea. The third page of the Tianji Record Fragment, after months of silence, finally manifested. The ancient golden text writhed and reorganized like a living thing, transforming into a cryptic and incomprehensible cultivation technique. He felt a sharp pain in his Brow Center as countless pieces of information flooded into his consciousness like a flood—this was the profound method of 'Causal Retrospection,' the second divine ability bestowed by the Tianji Record. The price was equally clear in his mind: each use consumed eight points of Heavenly Fate.

"Causal Retrospection can trace the causes and effects of any event in the world, with the time limit determined by the practitioner's cultivation." Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his ear. "Your current limit allows you to retrospect events from about three days ago." Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, golden light flickering in his pupils for an instant before vanishing. A meaningful smile curved his lips: "Three days ago... that was precisely when Ling Yuan struck me."

Chen Ji took a deep breath and, following the method transmitted by the Tianji Record, circulated his spiritual energy and touched the fetter that had plagued him for days—the strange seal binding his dantian. In an instant, the scene before him changed dramatically. He seemed to be standing in a river of time, going against the current to trace the truth. The blurry images gradually sharpened. He saw the moment when that fetter was first set—the caster was not Ling Yuan, but a blurry presence that did not belong to this world.

That presence was cold, vast, beyond mortal comprehension, like the will of Heaven itself towering above all living beings. Chen Ji's heart raced wildly, but he suppressed his shock and continued to retrospect—the fetter was not aimed at him, but at the inheritor of the Tianji Record. In other words, from the moment he obtained the Tianji Record, this fetter had already existed. Ling Yuan was merely the person being used to activate it. The Eye of Heavenly Dao regarded him as a chess piece, and he had been utterly unaware.

choice.prompt: After retrospecting the truth, Chen Ji faced a critical choice. Should he hide this new ability as indicated by the Tianji Record, or take a different path?

choices.description: Keep Causal Retrospection as a top secret and never reveal it lightly unless absolutely necessary, to avoid drawing the attention of greater forces.
choices.visible_reward: Ability Remains Hidden, Can Be Used as a Surprise Later

text.content: Chen Ji slowly收敛 his aura, drawing all that terrifying momentum back into his body. Mo Xiansheng nodded approvingly: "Knowing restraint is true wisdom. Every fluctuation of the Tianji Record draws attention. Your choice to endure is correct." Chen Ji did not respond, merely deeply inscribing the method of Causal Retrospection into the deepest part of his Mental Sea, like concealing a sword not yet drawn from its sheath.

choices.description: Strike while the iron is hot and continue to retrospect the fetter's origin, hoping to find a way to break it, or even reverse-trace the Eye of Heavenly Dao's true body.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate Drains Rapidly, May Fall into Weakness
choices.visible_reward: May Find a Way to Completely Break Free from the Fetter
choices.risk_hint: Huge Consumption and May Expose One's Whereabouts

text.content: A fierce glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. He bit the tip of his tongue and sprayed a mouthful of essence blood onto the third page of the Tianji Record. In an instant, he felt his consciousness seized by a violent force, hurtling upstream and crashing into a more distant past. However, just as he was about to touch the truth, a transcendent will descended abruptly, violently rebounding his divine sense. At that moment, he seemed to gaze into a pair of invisible eyes—the Eye of Heavenly Dao had already sensed his probing.

choices.description: Deliberately leave misleading traces in the Tianji Record, making any prying eyes believe the third page has not yet awakened.
choices.visible_cost: Requires Extra Effort to Set Up the Illusion
choices.risk_hint: Risk of Failure in Setting Up the Illusion

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes and concentrated, using the Tianji Record Fragment as the foundation to weave a layer of convincingly realistic false seals. This disguise exhausted most of his mental energy, but when Mo Xiansheng probed with his divine sense, even he could not distinguish the truth for a moment. "Excellent technique." Mo Xiansheng stroked his beard in admiration. "Even I was nearly fooled. It seems your skill at playing the pig to eat the tiger has improved another level."

At this moment, a familiar fluctuation came from his storage bag. Chen Ji took out the damaged communication jade talisman—the contact method left by the mysterious helper. A third line of text appeared on the talisman, its brushwork bold and unrestrained, revealing a transcendent insight into worldly affairs: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao is neither enemy nor friend. It is merely the rule itself. What you must oppose is never Heaven, but those who act in Heaven's name."

dialogue.content: "Those who act in Heaven's name..." Chen Ji murmured, repeating the words. His mind raced through Ling Yuan, the Holy Sect, and the始终 unseen mastermind behind the scenes. A terrifying conjecture gradually took shape—the Eye of Heavenly Dao might merely be a tool being used, the true chess player was someone else entirely. And he, Chen Ji, was merely one of the chosen chess pieces.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out at the appropriate moment, carrying a meaningful tone: "The fact that you can think to this level means the Tianji Record did not choose the wrong person. But remember, knowing the truth is one thing; how to respond is another." As his words fell, a warm object appeared in Chen Ji's palm—a piece of pitch-black chess piece, its style ancient and simple yet containing an inexplicable and profound energy. He recognized it. This was the 'Fate Chess Piece' recorded in the Tianji Record, the symbol of one who has entered the chess game.

Chen Ji stared at the chess piece in his palm, sensing the energy flowing within it resonating with his own bloodline. In that instant, he seemed to glimpse a fraction of the grand chess game of heaven and earth—countless points of light scattered like stars, each one a chess piece pulled by fate, and he, Chen Ji, had finally begun to metamorphose from a passive piece forced into the game to one who grasped the reins. This single chess piece was his first seat claimed in this game spanning millennia.

At this moment, a familiar voice suddenly rang out in his Mental Sea—Chen Ling. His sister had been missing for years, yet always managed to send information at critical moments. "Brother, I sensed your bloodline has advanced again. Congratulations on stepping into a new realm. But there is something you must know..." Chen Ling's voice was faint but clear. "The ultimate form of Causal Retrospection is not merely retrospection of causes. It can also see another possibility of fate—one that even the Eye of Heavenly Dao cannot predict."

choice.prompt: The information from Chen Ling was shocking. Chen Ji needed to decide the direction of his next move.

choices.description: Immediately use divine sense to question Chen Ling about the specific meaning of 'another possibility' and how to reach the ultimate form of Causal Retrospection.
choices.visible_cost: May Expose Chen Ling's Location to Enemies
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Key Information, Lay Foundation for Future Breakthrough
choices.risk_hint: Divine Sense Communication May Be Intercepted

dialogue.content: Chen Ling's voice echoed in his Mental Sea: "Brother, this world is shrouded by the Eye of Heavenly Dao. All fates are within its calculations. But there are always variables it cannot predict—those are the histories it deliberately erased, the causalities it sealed away. What I can tell you is that the answer lies in our Chen family's ancestral land, where things even the Eye of Heavenly Dao dares not gaze upon directly are sealed." Before she could finish, the communication cut off abruptly, as if severed by some kind of force.

choices.memory_label: 获得关键线索：陈家祖地藏有天道不敢直视的秘密

choices.description: Only briefly reply to confirm his sister's safety, without diving deeper into questions, to avoid divine sense communication being traced.
choices.risk_hint: May Miss Opportunity for In-Depth Exchange

dialogue.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the urge to press further, only replying briefly: "Be careful, contact me if anything happens." Chen Ling's response was equally restrained: "Brother, I'm fine here, but you should watch the internal movements of Tianqing Sect. Ling Yuan is extremely scheming. His armistice agreement probably hides other schemes." With that, her presence completely vanished from his Mental Sea, as if she had never appeared.

choices.memory_label: 陈灵提醒注意凌渊动向，停战协议或有图谋

text.content: Silence returned to the seclusion stone chamber. Chen Ji stored the Fate Chess Piece deep within his Mental Sea, placing it alongside the Tianji Record Fragment. Mo Xiansheng's figure gradually faded in the golden light, leaving only one meaningful warning: "The third page has opened, but your road has only just begun. Remember, the more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the fatal backlash of fate—this is the fate no inheritor through the ages has been able to escape."

Chen Ji rose and pushed open the stone door. The morning light was blinding, making him squint slightly. The Back Mountain of Tianqing Sect remained shrouded in mist, just as it was when he first arrived. But the him at this moment was no longer the废物杂役 from three months ago. Sixty percent bloodline awakening, the Tianji Record with three pages in hand, plus the Fate Chess Piece acquired—these unexpected harvests would make anyone who underestimated him regret it for a lifetime. But he knew the true challenge had only just begun.

At this moment, a sharp sword qi came piercing through the air from the direction of Tianqing Sect Main Peak. Su Qingyao's figure swept down like a startled phoenix, landing three zhang before Chen Ji. She still wore that cold expression, but there was a barely concealed scrutiny in her brow. "Seven days of seclusion with no sign of you. I thought something might have happened to you." Her voice was devoid of emotion, but those clear, cold eyes were scanning Chen Ji's entire body inch by inch, as if trying to see through him.

dialogue.content: "Is Senior Sister Su... worried about me?" A slight smile tugged at Chen Ji's lips. That harmless废物 smile重新挂上脸庞. "The safety of a mere servant disciple actually warrants the personal concern of the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow. What an honor."

text.content: Su Qingyao snorted coldly. Her slender fingers hovered over the sword hilt, and her aura suddenly surged: "Stop pretending with me. Seven days ago, Elder Ling personally struck and injured you. Yet afterward, you suddenly reached some kind of armistice agreement—I'd like to hear your own explanation of the process." Chen Ji's heart tightened slightly, but his face remained as serene as ever: "Senior Sister wants to hear? Why not come to my humble dwelling? Let me brew a pot of tea and I'll explain it slowly?"

The morning breeze brushed through the void between them, stirring a few falling leaves. Chen Ji calmly met Su Qingyao's gaze, but in his heart he was calculating rapidly—though this Inner Disciple Senior Fellow's favor had improved somewhat, she was always the person closest to the truth. How should he resolve this this time? Just as the atmosphere was about to solidify, a sudden commotion came from the direction of Tianqing Sect Outer Court. An outrageously arrogant laughter shattered the tranquility: "Hahahaha! You废物们 of Tianqing Sect, get out here for your young master!"
